name: Airtable
one_liner: Airtable is a cloud database/spreadsheet-hybrid platform with a REST Web API for programmatic access to bases, tables, and records.

evidence.quote: Free plan: 1000 API calls per month
Airtable enforces a rate limit of 5 requests per second (per base) to ensure optimal user performance across all pricing tiers.
The Airtable MCP server gives agents your base's full structure — field types, relationships, and views — so they can make context-aware decisions.
If you exceed your Free plan's call limit, a 30-day grace period is initiated, allowing you to continue using the API for that period.
As of February 1st 2024, the deprecation period for Airtable API keys has ended.
the token must have both the correct scope (`data.records:write`) and the base added to it as a resource
The API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON to encode objects, and relies on standard HTTP codes to signal operation outcomes.
Unauthenticated probe -> HTTP 401; WWW-Authenticate: None; body: {"error":{"type":"AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED","message":"Authentication required"}}

notes: API keys were fully deprecated Feb 1 2024; current auth is Personal Access Tokens (Bearer scheme) for individual dev use, or OAuth2 for third-party integrations requiring app registration at /create/oauth. Free-tier accounts can self-serve create PATs and use the API, but capped at 1000 calls/month and 5 req/sec per base — usable for prototyping/agents but a real constraint at scale. Official MCP server confirmed via /developers/agents with Claude Code plugin and npm CLI install paths. api_breadth estimated medium (records, bases/meta, webhooks, comments, attachments, fields endpoints) — exact count not verified against full API reference.
